text: Sodimac S.A. (Chile, RUT 96.792.430-K) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Falabella S.A.: Falabella's Memoria Anual 2025 names Sodimac S.A. among its CMF-registered subsidiaries and lists Falabella's total participation in it as 100%.
short: Falabella S.A. owns 100% of Sodimac S.A. (2025 annual report).

source.name: Falabella S.A.: Memoria Anual 2025 (sociedades filiales inscritas en la CMF)
source.quote: Las sociedades filiales inscritas en la CMF son las siguientes: FILIAL RUT N° INSCRIPCION Sodimac S.A. 96.792.430
source.note: English: Falabella's 2025 annual report lists Sodimac S.A. as a CMF-registered subsidiary; the subsidiaries table on p. 304 of the PDF gives 'Sodimac S.A. - 100 100 100 CHILE' (direct/indirect/total participation).
